categories.main_business_segments: Nanjing COSMOS Chemical Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the personal care raw materials industry, focusing on the research, production, and sales of cosmetic active ingredients such as sunscreen agents and synthetic fragrances. The company also produces amino acid surfactants and other personal care raw materials. Its product portfolio includes a wide range of sunscreen agents covering UVA and UVB spectra and synthetic fragrances used in cosmetics, detergents, and oral care products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has developed proprietary industrial production technologies including alkylation, acylation, condensation, hydrogenation, oxidation, etherification, and esterification. It holds numerous patents related to the synthesis of sunscreen agents and synthetic fragrances. Key technologies include decolorization-thin film distillation purification, high-efficiency recycling energy-saving technology, high-selectivity hydrogenation, green oxidation reactions, and Friedel-Crafts alkylation/acylation. The company also emphasizes green and environmentally friendly chemical processes.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major multinational cosmetics and specialty chemical companies such as DSM-FMC, Beiersdorf, Procter & Gamble, L'Oréal, Merck, and Johnson & Johnson for sunscreen agents. For synthetic fragrances, customers include Givaudan, IFF, Takasago, Mane, and Colgate. The products serve the personal care, cosmetics, detergent, and oral care industries, targeting global mainstream markets with a strong presence in both domestic and international markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with manufacturing bases in Nanjing, Suqian, Ma'anshan, Anqing, and overseas in Malaysia. Its products are sold extensively in domestic and international markets, with overseas sales accounting for approximately 87% of total revenue. The company has subsidiaries and joint ventures in Hong Kong, Singapore, and Malaysia, supporting its global supply and sales network.
categories.supply_chain_position: Nanjing COSMOS Chemical Co., Ltd. operates mainly in the midstream segment of the personal care raw materials supply chain, producing active ingredients and synthetic fragrances that are supplied to downstream cosmetics and personal care product manufacturers. It is a key raw material supplier with integrated R&D, production, and sales capabilities.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company focuses on technological innovation and product development, emphasizing safety, efficacy, and environmental sustainability. R&D priorities include expanding physical sunscreen agents, developing new personal care raw materials such as carbomers and high-end moisturizers, and enhancing formulation and application research. It aims to strengthen its international competitiveness through continuous innovation and capacity expansion, including the construction of a high-end personal care industry base and overseas production facilities.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the direct sale of chemical products, including cosmetic active ingredients and synthetic fragrances. The company employs a sales model combining direct sales to large customers and distribution through dealers for smaller clients. Export sales constitute a significant portion of revenue, with products sold under contracts and orders to global customers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is one of the world's leading manufacturers of sunscreen agents and a major player in the synthetic fragrance market. It competes with global chemical and specialty ingredient suppliers serving the personal care industry. Its comprehensive product portfolio, strong R&D capabilities, and international certifications position it as a competitive and reliable supplier in the global personal care raw materials market.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 2.28 billion, a slight decrease of 5.16% year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 562 million, down 23.33%. Total assets reached RMB 4.26 billion, growing 9.45% from the previous year. Despite short-term market fluctuations, the company maintains a solid financial foundation with positive cash flow from operations and ongoing investments in capacity expansion and R&D.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes a rich and diversified product portfolio covering all major sunscreen agent categories and synthetic fragrances, backed by strong proprietary technologies and patents. It offers high-quality, safe, and environmentally friendly products certified by international standards including FDA and EFfCI. Its integrated 'raw material plus formulation' service model enhances customer value by supporting product development and application innovation, strengthening customer partnerships and market competitiveness.
